message: 真の世界
After school. To steel ourselves, we decided to hold some Crusaders training.
The only problem was, how are we supposed to train our Guardian Angels' Spirit Power and techniques? For now, we had no idea.
The quickest and surest way would be to gain actual combat experience, but the risks are far too high.
First, just like any regular sports club, let's start with strength training. If we, the base bodies, get stronger ourselves, it's bound to carry over to our abilities after transforming.

name: Paqy
message: 「So, we came to the library to borrow some sports books, and yet...」

name: Azel
message: 「You're in my way」

name: Melilot
message: 「The world is so vast, and yet you're jumping straight into close-quarters combat?」

name: Azel
message: 「Let me through」

name: Melilot
message: 「No can do.」
Clutching a stack of large-format books, Azel was darting left and right trying to leave the front of the library, only to be blocked by Melilot-san every single time.

name: Azel
message: 「Move」

name: Melilot
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Azel
message: 「Go home」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have already returned. This library is my humble abode.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I knew it was true!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Sakura-kun, hello.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Melilot-san? Why are you blocking Azel's way?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because he is trying to take out more books than the prescribed limit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... yeah, true enough.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, please leave half of them behind. There is no need to read so many at once.」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not read. I merely look at the photographs within the books. Therefore, I do not violate the reading regulations.」

name: Azel
message: 「I want to see what I want to see. I want to see everything.」
With a dead-serious look in his eyes, Azel spouts an outrageous piece of sophistry.

name: Azel
message: 「I possess conviction, so I will not sway before any wind. What of you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Those are fine words, though you are using them in the wrong place.」

name: Azel
message: 「You are smiling. You are toying with me, aren't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Your expression hides love and hate. Won't you play with me?」
Just as Azel says, Melilot-san looks like she's having fun.
As a librarian, she's strict yet kind to everyone, which in other words means that due to her duties, she doesn't show special affection toward any specific individual.
And yet, what on earth is going on here?

name: Azel
message: 「If you don't let me go, I'll kill you!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you go, I'll super kill you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, you. Do something about this woman.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, arguments are all about case studies. There's no way us younger kids could ever out-argue Melilot-san, even if we stood on our heads!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, you are the Student Council President, and you possess the authority.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I cannot allow it. Precisely because I am the Student Council President, I must not give Azel alone special treatment.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no need for your help」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you just ask for it?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I don't care!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san, the most vital duty of anyone attending Ryuusei Academy is to uphold freedom and responsibility」

name: Melilot
message: 「In academics, club activities, personal conduct--everything. That is the fundamental principle Helena established」

name: Azel
message: 「She just decided that on her own」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you do not hold that conviction and cannot face the truth squarely, you have no right to wear that uniform or carry a library card」

name: Azel
message: 「M-My card? Then I won't be able to borrow even a single book?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, well then, Melilot-san, I'll use my freedom to do this」
I take half of the books Azel is carrying.
They're all photo collections. And not of World Heritage sites or scenic spots either, but solely of Ryuusei Town's rows of houses, back alleys, and the everyday lives of its people.

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh right, you're an exchange student, Azel. So you're trying to learn about everyone~」

name: Azel
message: 「Something like that. So give them back」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel will borrow up to her maximum limit, and I'll borrow whatever remaining books don't fit. How does that sound?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no issue with that whatsoever」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, any books checked out under Sakura-kun's name must be returned under Sakura-kun's responsibility」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, your library card--」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go」
Taking the library card from me, Melilot-san begins writing the book titles onto the checkout log on the back right there on the spot.

name: Azel
message: 「What is wrong with you... with you two?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am a librarian」

name: Synn
message: 「And I'm the Student Council President?」

name: Azel
message: 「I know that! Hurry up and finish the paperwork!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am just finishing up」

name: Melilot
message: 「Books are wonderful, and knowledge is a lovely thing. However, there are times when that alone is not enough, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Believe, and all is truth; doubt, and all is a hazy chaos. What is reality and what is an empty dream--you are the one who decides」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up」

name: Azel
message: 「Still... is this world really something so unstable?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are as many worlds as there are people」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you mistake mere doubt for intellect, refuse to believe what should be believed, and deny what stands before you, only the darkness of confusion will remain, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I told you to shut up!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, here is your library card back」

name: Azel
message: 「Tch!」
Azel bolts straight toward the girls' dorm.

name: Melilot
message: 「If she were to trip and fall, damaging the books... Sakura-kun, you understand what that means, yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「Guh...! A-Azel, wait!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're going to read them in your dorm room, right? I'll carry the books to the entrance for you」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't thank you. After all, I never asked you to」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mind, it's nothing much. It's just...」

name: Azel
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why don't you use the reading room? Inside the library, you can read as many books as you want」

name: Azel
message: 「...You don't know?」

name: Azel
message: 「When I'm looking at photo books or art books in there, that woman closes right in on me and starts talking」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Talking is strictly prohibited in the library, isn't it? Oh! Maybe she's explaining the contents of the books to you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong」

name: Azel
message: 「That woman just keeps talking, muttering in a quiet voice, on and on without stopping」

name: Azel
message: 「So I can't get a word in, muttering on and on, keeping up a nonstop stream of talk like hypnosis」

name: Azel
message: 「And then I gradually start getting sleepy, and that woman mutters in a quiet voice, can't get a word in, on and on--」
I can't believe Ms. Melilot would pull something like that on a student.
Even more unbelievable is that Azel is complaining to me. Even if it's just griping and grumbling, Azel and I are actually communicating.
Could it be that Ms. Melilot wanted us to end up like this, so she intentionally pulled something unbelievable on a student, and Azel is complaining, and we're communicating.
Even if it's just griping and grumbling, what's unbelievable is that we're--
Oh no, it's contagious! Even my own words are getting messed up!
I'll come back another time to borrow the sports books.
